description: Starfighter gate guard at Akhisar air base, wearing the code 9-164. Construction number 683D-7164. The International F-104 Society records German Marinefliegergeschwader 1 badges applied to the airframe. Confirmed present on Esri World Imagery examined September 2026, which resolves a white aircraft on a plinth beside the approach road among trees.
museum_name: Akhisar Air Base F-104 Gate Guard -- Manisa
